arbitrary_suffix.claim: F^(k+2)(1 2^k 1 v) = F^(k+2)(2^(k+1) 1 v) for every four-state v, k>=2

chaining.claim: The leftmost defect-gap-defect pattern reduces regardless of what follows, since the lemma holds for arbitrary suffix v.

all_k_induction.proved: J(2^k 1) begins (2,2) for every k>=2, hence the absorption lemma at zero padding holds for every k>=2, not only the checked range.

scope: U for k>=2 at zero padding: proved for every k, not a tested range, via pure_run_closed_form + all_k_induction (locality of inverse_terminal/peel/terminal, plus the pure-2 background being a fixed point). C (exact finite certificates) for the boundary cases k=0 (needs padding 5) and k=1 (needs padding 1) and for arbitrary_suffix/chaining, which are checked over a finite range as controls on the k>=2 proof, not proofs themselves. Says nothing about defects separated by more than one intervening defect at once, or about the full RW/DLP hard-core source language.
